description:
optional, enumerated string filter
Status of the coupon code. Possible values are : not_redeemed, redeemed, archived.
Supported operators : is, is_not, in, not_in

Example → status[is] = "redeemed"

is.description: \* \`not_redeemed\` - Can be applied to a subscription. \* \`redeemed\` - Cannot be applied to a subscription as the coupon code has been already used. \* \`archived\` - Cannot be applied to a subscription as it has been made inactive.

is_not.description: \* \`not_redeemed\` - Can be applied to a subscription. \* \`redeemed\` - Cannot be applied to a subscription as the coupon code has been already used. \* \`archived\` - Cannot be applied to a subscription as it has been made inactive.
